title: Shared moving-target admission, analyzer extension contracts, and retained corpse damage
acceptance_criteria: Nominated living pickup and pull share reach and block-LOS admission without requiring the current server aim ray; Pullable, authority, containment and hand reservations remain action-specific, and automatic item selection is unchanged.

Analyzer presentation has no mob-specific branches; entity-owned immutable appearance capture drives copy and comparison, and dynamic resolved-catalog contracts reject missing species, missing factories and unsupported appearance fallback for newly supported hosts of any namespace.

Already-retained medically Dead bodies receive native and typed damage through normal NeoForge mitigation, cancellation and canonical typed-ledger events without resurrection, duplicate commits or repeated death processing; unsupported native corpses are unchanged.

Corpse fall/native hits and physical pressure, temperature, fire and explosion eligibility preserve identity and component/source conditions; respiration and bloodloss shutdown rules are not globally relaxed.
Fresh full JVM, full native, affected UI/interaction/prediction readiness, isolated client startup and packaging pass; connected input and GPU quality remain owner checks.
manual_steps: Throw a mouse horizontally and immediately Ctrl-left-click it to pull. Compare pickup; repeat with a critical/dead mouse. Out-of-reach and wall-blocked targets must still deny.
Drop a dead mouse and a dead Human/Pig from a damaging height. Compare analyzer damage before/after; the same body must remain Dead. Check existing fire/explosion exposure where available.

Scan healthy/critical/dead Mouse and Human/Pig: correct state, species and appearance. Confirm held-camera smoothness, five-second escape across hand transfers, real-drop interruption and cursor cleanup remain intact.
